description: This file contains functions for merging environment details into tool result content within message objects, specifically for the MiniMax model. It manipulates message content blocks, merging text blocks into the last tool_result block, and includes a deprecated function for backward compatibility.

methods.name: mergeEnvironmentDetailsForMiniMax
methods.description: Merges text content following tool_result blocks into the last tool_result's content to preserve reasoning continuity in messages.

methods.name: extractEnvironmentDetailsForMiniMax
methods.description: Deprecated function that returns merged messages and an empty array for extracted system content, maintained for backward compatibility.
